tspan.tspan: The order arrives by email, fax or PDF. A fax is scanned on
the copier into a file.
Attachments (PDF, images) of mail to order-intake@ go into
the intake folder. One attachment = one order acceptance.
Production only.
Drop many files from Order intake (or straight into the share
d folder). Picked up by the 60-second scan or Scan now.
Priority intake on the list takes several files. They skip the
folder and appear in the list at once.
An order acceptance with an ORD- number is created in stat
us Importing.
Reads customer, item names, quantities, prices and dates.
1–3 min per document.
Connection errors, congestion and malformed output are retr
ied up to 3 times (orange Retrying).
The red Extraction failed badge gives cause and next step.
Re-extract, or Switch to manual entry to make it a draft and
type it in.
Learned spellings first, then fuzzy matching; only a single
hit is filled in. Status becomes Draft and the intake group is
notified.
Create by hand: enter customer and lines, then create the d
raft (status Draft).
Compare with the original, Edit and save. Only a Draft can b
e edited.
Pick a suggestion or search. Saving learns the spelling so
the next document matches automatically.
The item is a regrind item; the customer's tool is picked fro
m products (external products allowed).
Only when selling off the price list: turn on Override the unit
price. It is intended, so not a mismatch.
Lines with no price list for that customer and item take any
price.
Enabled once customer, lines, every item and price (and to
ol for regrind) are set. Status Pending approval.
Lines differing from the list without override, or with no mat
ching tier, must be acknowledged first.
Approval settings choose the flow by total, delivery method
and site, and notify the first group.
From the order acceptance or the Pending list. When the st
ep's approvers (any one / all) approve, it moves on.
Returns to Draft with a reason. Fix and request approval ag
ain.
Confirm, then Expand. Status Approved → Confirmed.
Each line gets ORD-…-01, -02, its amount is frozen and its s
tatus is Confirmed.
Work orders and delivery orders start from the order lines. Q
uantity, price and item are fixed now.
Optional. Moves a confirmed order acceptance to Archived;
no more edits.
Request for the whole confirmed order acceptance, with a r
eason. Not possible once any line is shipped.
Nothing changes until final approval. Send back closes the
request and leaves the order as is.
Order lines and acceptance become Cancelled, reservation
s are released and open work orders are cancelled (combin
ed lots stay).
Creates a new Draft carrying over the cancelled order acce
ptance's content.

svg.text: Order intake — from receiving the order to confirming order lines
